notes: Never exclude on the command text alone. Attacker can host an identical one-liner anywhere.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Parent is an interactive admin shell AND not launched from explorer.exe AND domain on vendor list
notes: Chocolatey's official installer. Trips almost every PowerShell rule at once. This is the single worst FP source on Windows.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Host is on an internal allowlist AND parent is an interactive admin shell
notes: This is the exact malicious shape. Only an internal-host allowlist separates them and that allowlist is itself an evasion target.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Signed Microsoft binary AND no remote URL argument
notes: Safe to downweight. No fetch-and-execute of arbitrary script text.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Base64 decodes to JSON with alg/typ keys AND no interpreter token present
notes: JWTs are structurally identifiable. Decode and check for a JOSE header.

suggested_exclusion_condition: PEM armor markers present AND no interpreter token
notes: Same for PRIVATE KEY RSA KEY and OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY blocks.

benign_pattern: .env contents / API keys / Docker auth config
suggested_exclusion_condition: KEY=VALUE line structure AND no interpreter token
notes: Entropy alone must never score above threshold without an execution context.

benign_pattern: Git commit SHAs object hashes checksums
suggested_exclusion_condition: Length is exactly 40 or 64 hex chars with no surrounding command
notes: Trivially excluded by shape.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Known cmdlet verb-noun prefix AND no encoding AND no remote fetch
notes: Long length and admin privilege are not signals on their own.

suggested_exclusion_condition: mktemp present in same command
notes: Conventional and rarely in attack chains.

suggested_exclusion_condition: No -urlcache no -decode and no URL argument
notes: Hashing is the common benign certutil use. -urlcache -split -f with a URL is the malicious one.

benign_pattern: rundll32 with a documented system DLL export
suggested_exclusion_condition: DLL resolves under System32 AND no remote path
notes: rundll32 pointing at a user-writable or temp path is near-always malicious.

benign_pattern: curl / wget against an API endpoint for testing
suggested_exclusion_condition: Output goes to stdout or a file not an interpreter
notes: The pipe target is the whole signal.

benign_pattern: git clone / pip install / npm install from public registries
suggested_exclusion_condition: Known package manager binary
notes: Supply chain risk exists but is out of scope for a ClickFix detector.

benign_pattern: Credential blobs pasted from 1Password Bitwarden etc
suggested_exclusion_condition: Source application is a known password manager
notes: Capture the source app and suppress. Also a privacy requirement: never log these.

benign_pattern: Minified JS bundles base64 data URIs Terraform state
suggested_exclusion_condition: No interpreter token at the start of the clipboard content
notes: Entropy gated behind an execution context removes nearly all of these.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Pipeline terminates at base64 -d with no shell after it
notes: Only suppress when nothing executes the decoded output.

suggested_exclusion_condition: -File points to a local or UNC path not a URL AND parent is a management agent
notes: -File with a path is materially safer than -Command or -enc with inline content.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Destination host is internal AND result is not passed to an interpreter
notes: Downloading to a file is not the risk. Downloading and immediately executing is.

benign_pattern: Build scripts and CI writing to /tmp %TEMP% ~/.cache
suggested_exclusion_condition: Parent is a build tool (make cargo npm gradle docker) or CI runner
notes: Staging path only scores when paired with a fetch and an execute in the same window.

benign_pattern: certutil -encode / -decode on a local certificate file
suggested_exclusion_condition: Input and output are both local paths AND output is not executed
notes: Decoding to a PE in a temp directory is the malicious variant.

suggested_exclusion_condition: MSI path is local or internal UNC not a remote URL
notes: msiexec with an http URL is high signal.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Not writing to a Run key OR parent is a management agent
notes: Run key writes deserve their own score regardless of parent.

suggested_exclusion_condition: Archive source is a local path not a just-downloaded temp file
notes: The curl then Expand-Archive then wscript sequence is the signal not extraction alone.

benign_pattern: docker run with many flags; ffmpeg; kubectl jsonpath; awk/sed pipelines; find -exec
suggested_exclusion_condition: None needed
notes: Length and chaining are near-useless as standalone features. Do not weight them.
